name: eu-careers
description: End-to-end support for candidates targeting EU civil service competitions (EPSO). Covers the notice of competition, eligibility and the application form, preparation for the computer-based tests and the written test, selection panel interviews and presentations, grade and net salary calculation, and job offer analysis under the Staff Regulations.

skills.description: Personalise this plugin to the candidate's profile, target competition, and current preparation stage
Decode the notice of competition, check eligibility condition by condition, draft the application form entries, and assemble the supporting documents and deadline calendar
Prepare the EPSO computer-based tests: scoring priorities, study plan, timed practice questions, score simulator, remote-proctoring test-day protocol
Coach and mark the EPSO written test (EUFTE, WT, FRWT) against EPSO's five published written-communication anchors
Estimate entry grade, step (SR Art. 32) and net monthly salary with full working, from the pay table in force
Coach presentations and interviews before EU selection panels; score drafts against the anchors of EPSO's 2023 competency framework
Analyse a job offer: contract type, grade and step check, gross-to-net breakdown, one-off payments, probation, deadlines and questions for HR
